messages.text:
Good place to start, honestly — it's the best value per terahash we sell. $799 for 40 TH/s, quiet desktop tower, ~50 dB in Eco, and it solo mines to your own node.

Two things decide if it's right for you: where it'll sit, and what power costs you. Where are you thinking of putting it?
on my work desk so electricity is free

Free power changes the math a lot — then the 40T is the one. Honest heads-up though: it's 650W at 40 TH/s, so it's a small space heater on your desk, and ~50 dB in Eco, about conversation volume. Fine in a workshop, noticeable in a quiet shared office.

Is the desk somewhere you'd mind that?
